hebrewText: צַ֚ו אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וִֽ/ישַׁלְּחוּ֙ מִן הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה כָּל צָר֖וּעַ וְ/כָל זָ֑ב וְ/כֹ֖ל טָמֵ֥א לָ/נָֽפֶשׁ

tokens.kjv: appoint, (for-) bid, (give a) charge, (give a, give in, send with) command(-er, -ment), send a messenger, put, (set) in order.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.
tokens.explanation: ben — filho, descendente, membro de um grupo (bar em aramaico)

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
tokens.explanation: Yisrael — nome dado a Jacó (aquele que luta com Deus)

tokens.bdb: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, [idiom] earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).
tokens.explanation: shalach — enviar, mandar, despachar, estender a mão

tokens.bdb: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
tokens.kjv: above, after, among, at, because of, by (reason of), from (among), in, [idiom] neither, [idiom] nor, (out) of, over, since, [idiom] then, through, [idiom] whether, with.

tokens.bdb: an encampment (of travellers or troops); hence, an army, whether literal (of soldiers) or figurative (of dancers, angels, cattle, locusts, stars; or even the sacred courts)
tokens.kjv: army, band, battle, camp, company, drove, host, tents.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: to scourge, i.e. (intransitive and figurative) to be stricken with leprosy
properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: to flow freely (as water), i.e. (specifically) to have a (sexual) flux; figuratively, to waste away; also to overflow
tokens.kjv: flow, gush out, have a (running) issue, pine away, run.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
tokens.kjv: any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, [idiom] dead(-ly), desire, [idiom] (dis-) contented, [idiom] fish, ghost, [phrase] greedy, he, heart(-y), (hath, [idiom] jeopardy of) life ([idiom] in jeopardy), lust, man, me, mind, mortally, one, own, person, pleasure, (her-, him-, my-, thy-) self, them (your) -selves, [phrase] slay, soul, [phrase] tablet, they, thing, ([idiom] she) will, [idiom] would have it.
tokens.explanation: nefesh — alma, ser vivo, vida, pessoa, desejo interior
